description: This Java class 'Indices' defines several MongoDB indices used by the 'thingsearch' persistence module within the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies indices for query optimization and data management purposes related to things search functionality.

classes.name: Indices
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods to access MongoDB index configurations for the 'thingsearch' persistence layer.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of all defined indices used for MongoDB collection optimization.
